about: El Mil Amores is a Mexican brunch spot in San Francisco's Mission District — Mexico City-style breakfast and lunch plates, walk-in only, home of the famous Concha French Toast.

services.name: CDMX Plate
services.description: Chilaquiles, soft scrambled eggs, crispy home potatoes and concha French toast on one plate, $20.

services.name: Concha French Toast
services.description: Sweet concha bread as French toast with fresh strawberries — the fan favourite, $14.

services.name: Chilaquiles Verdes
services.description: Classic chilaquiles in vibrant salsa verde.

services.name: Tres Leches Pancakes
services.description: Pancakes soaked in tres leches — moist, sweet and indulgent.

services.name: Café de Olla
services.description: Traditional coffee brewed with cinnamon and piloncillo, $4.50.

services.name: Mole Colorado con Pollo
services.description: Roasted chicken in deep, complex Mole Colorado, $18.
